title: Dusk Maiden of Amnesia — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The genes do not care about Dusk Maiden of Amnesia; they care about copies. Dusk Maiden of Amnesia (Japanese: 黄昏乙女×アムネジア, Hepburn: Tasogare Otome × Amunejia), stylized as Dusk maiden of Amnesia, is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by the duo Maybe. It was published by Square Enix and serialized in the Monthly Gangan Joker magazine from April 2009 to June 2013, with its chapters collected in ten tankōbon volumes.

Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about Dusk Maiden of Amnesia. She originally believed that Yuuko was an evil spirit until she learns the truth: that she was seeing Shadow Yuuko. Kirie resembles Yuuko albeit with short hair and a smaller bust as her grandmother is Yuuko's younger sister.
